name: optcatalog_play_trigger_inactive_warning
description: OptCatalog::PlayTriggerInactiveWarning plays the shared trigger-inactive warning sample at full gain.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a zWeapon/OptCatalog source-cluster pass; this target records functional evidence for the warning-sample dispatch.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0600 validates loading g_OptCatalogSndTriggerInactive and calling zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple with 1.0f.

The native smoke drives the warning helpers through a DirectSound test buffer with distinct sample globals, verifies each PlayA3DSimple path reaches backend playback, and verifies the trigger-inactive helper selects the trigger-inactive sample as the active owner.
